about.title: About us
about.intro: {name} is an electrical contracting firm that executes electrical installation and maintenance works on tender and contract basis.
story: We take up electrical works from enquiry to handover: site survey, estimation, supply of material, installation, testing, commissioning and liaison with the electricity authorities where required.

Our clients include government departments and PSUs that award work through tenders, industries and commercial establishments that issue RFQs, builders who need complete electrification of their projects, and facilities that need a dependable maintenance partner.

values.title: Clear scope
values.text: Every job starts with a written scope, BOQ and schedule agreed with the client.

values.title: Quality material
values.text: Approved makes as per specification, with test certificates handed over.

values.title: Qualified people
values.text: Licensed supervisors and wiremen, with engineers overseeing execution.

values.title: Proper handover
values.text: As-built drawings, test reports and completion documents at the end of the job.

strength: Skilled wiremen, cable jointers and fitters
Testing instruments: insulation tester, earth tester, relay test kit, clamp meters
Tools and tackle for HT/LT cable laying and termination

government.title: Government and PSU
government.summary: Tender works for departments, boards, municipal bodies and public sector units.
government.intro: We participate in open and limited tenders and execute rate contracts for government bodies, following departmental specifications and schedules of rates.
points: Pre-qualification documents kept ready: licence, registrations, turnover and work experience
Execution as per departmental specifications and approved makes
Measurement books, running bills and completion documents in the required format
Coordination with the electrical inspectorate and distribution company

industrial.title: Industrial and commercial
industrial.summary: Factories, warehouses, offices, hospitals, hotels and institutions.
industrial.intro: For plants and commercial buildings we handle new installations, expansions and shutdown jobs, planned around your production and occupancy.
points: HT/LT substations, transformers, panels and bus ducts
Cable laying, trays and power distribution up to the machine
Itemised quotation against your RFQ or BOQ

builders.title: Builders and residential
builders.summary: Townships, apartment blocks, villas and commercial complexes.
builders.intro: We take complete electrification of real-estate projects, from the incoming supply to the last light point, in step with your civil schedule.
points: Internal wiring, DBs, rising mains and meter panels
External electrification: street lighting, feeder pillars and cabling
DG backup, lifts and common-area power

amc.title: AMC and maintenance
amc.summary: Annual maintenance contracts and breakdown support for existing installations.
amc.intro: Keep your electrical installation healthy with scheduled preventive maintenance and fast breakdown response.
points: Preventive maintenance of transformers, panels and DG sets
Periodic testing: earthing, insulation resistance and relay checks
Breakdown attendance with a committed response time
Maintenance records and reports after every visit

process.title: Submit
process.text: Share your requirement with BOQ, drawings or the tender document.

process.title: Review
process.text: Our estimation team studies the scope and raises queries if any.

process.title: Site visit
process.text: Where needed, an engineer visits the site before pricing.

process.title: Offer
process.text: You receive our techno-commercial offer within the due date.

faq.a: The tender document or RFQ, BOQ and drawings if available. PDF, Excel, Word, DWG and ZIP files are accepted.
You get a reference number immediately. Our team normally reverts within two working days, or earlier if the due date is close.

faq.q: Do you take supply-only or labour-only contracts?
faq.a: Yes. We take turnkey, supply-and-installation and labour-rate contracts depending on the tender conditions.

faq.q: Can you share your pre-qualification documents?
faq.a: Yes. Mention it in the message and we will email the licence, registrations and experience certificates.

privacy.title: What we collect
privacy.text: When you submit a form we collect the details you enter (name, organisation, phone, email, location, work requirement) and any documents you attach.

privacy.title: How we use it
privacy.text: We use this information only to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotations and offers, and stay in touch about the work.

privacy.title: Sharing
privacy.text: We do not sell your information. It is shared only with our staff and service providers (such as email and hosting) who need it to handle your enquiry.

privacy.title: Retention and your choices
privacy.text: We keep enquiry records for our business and statutory needs. You can ask us to correct or delete your details by writing to us.

terms.title: Information on this site
terms.text: Content on this website is for general information about our services. It is not an offer; a binding scope and price are stated only in our written quotation or agreement.

terms.title: Enquiries and documents
terms.text: By submitting an enquiry you confirm you are authorised to share the documents you upload. We treat tender and project documents as confidential.

terms.title: Reference numbers
terms.text: A reference number confirms that we received your enquiry. It does not mean we have accepted the work.
